ns2:course.label: Honors Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: Two-term research project. May be repeated in separate terms for a total of 6 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Senior majors in religious studies who are eligible for graduating with distinction from the program.
